THE CONSTRAINT
Every artboard is 1280 px wide with a 1240 px content band — the width that still fits a 1366-wide laptop after Excel's row headers and scrollbar. Nothing sits to the right of the band, so the sheet scrolls vertically only.

SUMMARY
Verdict, six tiles, full-width table, the two key plots side by side, then four supporting plots in one row. The locator map and at-a-glance facts move below the charts — they are what pushes the sheet off-screen today.
The shared rules, plus the table at the bottom giving the exact Excel chart widths this implies.
